blends.name: Dr. Zammsy the Animated Series Sneak Peak
blends.desc:
Dr. Zammsy the Animated Series Sneak Peak.

The animated series brings us back to his youth. 

We get to meet a 20 year old Dr. Theodore Zammsy. Since birth, childhood prodigy Dr. Z has wanted to be known as one of the greatest scientists of all time. For him, there’s no experiment too dangerous, no theory too outrageous, no research too explosive to improve the lives of his fellow citizens; just so long as he gets credit for doing it. So what if he’s blown up 3 of Halobridge’s research labs? No one said saving the world wouldn’t be messy. Despite having a good heart and noble goals, Dr. Z’s inexperience, youth and reckless behavior keep his dreams out of reach. If he can reel himself in and learn to share the glory with others, he might just end up being as good as he thinks he is.
